name: Royal Champagne
positioning: Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa, a pale-stone hillside hotel overlooking the Champagne vineyards and the Marne Valley, with a Michelin-starred restaurant and a large spa
best_for: Travelers who want spa time between champagne house visits

facts.text: Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa overlooks the vineyards on the hills of the Champagne region.
The hotel is a pale-stone building, a kind of modern amphitheatre, overlooking the whole Marne Valley.
The surrounding Champagne hillsides are UNESCO World Heritage listed.
Epernay and its Avenue de Champagne, home to Moet & Chandon, Dom Perignon and Perrier-Jouet, are even closer to the hotel than Reims.
Reims and Epernay can be reached by TGV from Paris Gare de l'Est in 45 minutes, or by a private transfer arranged by the concierge.
The rooms and suites have no facing neighbours and open through bay windows onto the heart of Champagne.
The interior decorator took inspiration from the natural and cultural heritage of the region, favouring natural materials.
Le Royal restaurant holds one star in the 2025 Michelin Guide.
Executive chef Christophe Raoux was named Meilleur Ouvrier de France in 2015.
Le Bellevue, the bistronomic restaurant, has a 180-degree panorama over the Epernay and Marne valley.
The spa has nine treatment rooms, indoor and outdoor pools, a hammam, a sauna, whirlpool baths, a yoga studio, a fitness room and a beauty salon.
A tennis court a few steps from the hotel is reserved exclusively for guests.

highlights.text: Le Royal sits in the historic part of the hotel, under a gold-patinated ceiling, in a salon paying homage to the women in Napoleon's life.
The hotel arranges a royal picnic in the vineyards, with a menu by chef Christophe Raoux, set up by a private butler.
At nightfall, Le Bellevue is lit by a thousand crystal pendants hanging from its ceiling.
The experience team organises private visits to prestigious champagne houses and lesser-known producers.
The spa offers a Bonpoint treatment ritual for children from age 6.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the vineyards rather than in Reims itself; Reims is 20 minutes away.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
